[![Issue](https://img.shields.io/badge/template-feature%20request-2563eb)](../../ROADMAP.md)

## Problem

What concrete user or engineering problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior without assuming a specific implementation.

## Why existing behavior is insufficient

Explain the gap and who is affected.

## Alternatives

List reasonable alternatives or workarounds considered.

## Success criteria

How would we know this feature works?

## Security / privacy / performance impact

Call out new trust boundaries, remote execution, sensitive data, or benchmark-sensitive claims.
